## LV Contact Ingest — CLOUD template
Import to n8n Cloud, then add **HubSpot credentials** on the three HubSpot nodes (search / update / create).

**Flow:** Webhook upload -> Extract-from-File -> inlined Code nodes (map/normalize/resolve/merge) -> IF(action) -> HubSpot update / create (GATED, off by default) / Set review.

**Email verify:** real HTTP node -> rapid-email-verifier batch API (up to 100/call); non-gating fallback if unreachable.

**AU-phone DISCLAIMER:** the inline JS is an AU-only heuristic (no libphonenumber in Code nodes). Non-AU / ambiguous numbers -> null -> review. Swap in a phone-validation API for global coverage.
